title: Sum Of Beauty Of All Substrings
description:
The beauty of a string is the frequency of its most common character minus the frequency of its least common character among characters that appear. Return the sum of the beauty values of all non-empty substrings of `s`.

## Examples

```text
Input: s = "aabcb"
Output: 5
```

```text
Input: s = "aabcbaa"
Output: 17
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= s.length <= 500`
- `s` contains only lowercase English letters.
